in_sanskrit.name: Charanpreet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Loved by God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Charanpreet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Charan: footsteps, preet: love. The name Charanpreet signifies being loved by the divine. It is a name rooted in Hindu mythology, where devotion and love for the gods are highly valued.

in_hindi.name: चरणप्रीत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one whose feet evoke feelings of love
